title: Introduction
content: This is a simple pygame 2D platformer build within a span of two weeks. The main focus of this project was to understand some of the basics of creating games using pygame.

title: Getting Started
content:
To begin, clone the repository and install the dependencies:

git clone https://github.com/ccarson1/MedDays.git
python3 -m venv env
env\Scripts\activate
pip install pygame
